content.text: The greeting module exports a constant.

The formal-style update compiled cleanly across all three resume variants. Summary of changes to `chicv.typ`:

- **Icons removed** — `iconlink`/`githublink` no longer prefix links with FontAwesome glyphs (envelope/phone/github); contact info and project links now render as plain text.
- **Links de-emphasized** — dropped the underline `show` rule, so hyperlinks look like normal prose rather than web-style links (still clickable in the PDF).
- **Bolder name heading** — h1 weight changed from `"light"` to `"bold"`.
- **Darker section rule** — `chiline()` stroke changed from gray to `0.5pt + black`.

Verified by rebuilding all three variants (`resume.pdf`, `resume-cn.pdf`, `resume-elab.pdf`) via `build-linux.sh` and visually inspecting the output — no icons, no underlines, bold name, dark section rules, single-page layout preserved for `resume.pdf` (the CN/elaborate variants were already 2 pages before this change, unrelated to the styling edits). Wording in `main.typ` was untouched.
